output.text: Begin with paper rain: rub sheets of paper together softly. Allow two silent beats—no sound, no movement. Then, one performer begins the lowest hum they can sustain comfortably. Others join individually, each adding their hum at will. No signals, no cues. When the paper falls, the last performer stops. The piece ends when the final sheet settles. Maintain a spare and exact tone. Each hum must be precise, each silence deliberate. The lowest hum must remain steady. The paper rain must be the only initial gesture. Two silent beats must be absolute. Let the sound dissolve with the fall.
